title: Audit deferred-row rounding: sharp error bounds and clean-return controls
body:
Adds one isolated numerical-interface audit. A sole rounding error of 1/2 in a temporary row causes retained error 2; final deletion is a norm-one projection, but internal errors need suffix accounting. The explicit two-phase model has sharp independent-defect bounds 1 (normalized) and 4 (raw). Retained-only tests can miss omitted cleanup. **No new κ.**

This complements PR6115's cost audit and credits PR6110's handoff and PR5081's computed-input error work. The selected fixed-grid program is unchanged; no bug in PR6030 is alleged.

Base: `721c03822c421b7f7fcbb2598993b947c4d88419`. All eight input/source pins are in SOURCES.json. Published commit: `bdfe5a10d488b5f774e906d8d4588dc8da25e7ba`. Its complete tree `63636bc666c2fe62588971e6948c8c902a7ed343` equals the tested local tree.

Reproduce:
`python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/deferred-row-rounding-audit`
Expected: PASS_DEFERRED_ROW_ROUNDING_AUDIT and PASS_ROW_ROUNDING_MUTATIONS in normal and optimized modes.

Executed: 208 exact matrix coefficients; sharp bound with attaining defects; all 6,561 nonlinear inputs, 81 dense cross-checks, 1,300 channel fixtures; ten actual private-copy faults rejected per mode. Metadata, committed bytes/source history, 17-file export and Git-free replay pass; exported hashes unchanged.

Scope: a conditional numerical lemma and explicit surrogate, not an emitted native caller. Actual gate-error/range bounds, physical disposal costs and all five framework assumptions remain. No selected cold replay, hosted CI, human review or proof-kernel acceptance claimed.

Prepared by @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit Vlado-V, zxv, DreamingOfClouds, Ali Romman, Douglas Colkitt, JosieElliston, DLamdata, JoyboyBrian and retained predecessors. Apache-2.0.
